# `nlink-lab benchmark`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Run a `benchmark` block from a deployed lab's topology.

Collects the metrics the block asks for (`ping` latency/loss, `iperf3` throughput, and with `udp` jitter/loss) and evaluates each `assert` against them. A test that measured nothing says why. Omit the name to list the lab's benchmarks.

JSON OUTPUT (with `--json`): the full `BenchmarkResult` (per test: the metric map, every assertion with its actual value, and the pass flag). Exit 2 when any assertion fails.

Usage: nlink-lab benchmark [OPTIONS] [NAME]

Arguments:
  [NAME]
          Benchmark name as declared in the topology (`benchmark "name" { … }`). Omit to list the benchmarks the lab defines

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
